cues.en: Darn it. My computer froze again.
cues.zh: 该死，我电脑又死机了。

cues.en: You know, it hasn't been the same since that virus attacked the system. Did anyone call Nick Burns? Yeah. I called him about half hour ago. He told me to go soak my head.
cues.zh: 你知道，自从病毒攻击系统后，它就再也不一样了。有人打电话给Nick Burns了吗？打了，我半小时前打给他的。他让我去清醒清醒。

cues.en: I don't like that guy.
cues.zh: 我不喜欢那家伙。

cues.en: Well, I tried to run that Norton program to fix it, but it didn't work. And I don't know That's because Norton Utilities can only detect a virus. It can't repair your hard drive after you download an infected program, Patch Adams.
cues.zh: 我试过运行那个Norton程序来修复，但没用。我不知道，那是因为Norton Utilities只能检测病毒。在你下载了一个受感染的程序后，它没法修复你的硬盘，Patch Adams。

cues.en: Okay, blockheads. I'm getting ready to go on vacation. I'm training the new guy. If you need any help, you call him this week. Alright? Come on in here, Wang.
cues.zh: 好了，笨蛋们。我准备去度假了。我正在培训新人。这周你们需要帮助的话，就找他。明白吗？进来吧，Wang。

cues.en: Hi, everybody.
cues.zh: 大家好。

cues.en: Hi, Wang. Alright. Who's having a problem? I can't open my phone. Alright. One at a time. My my brain doesn't have a zip drive.
cues.zh: 你好，Wang。好了。谁有问题？我手机打不开。好了。一个一个来。我的大脑可没有压缩驱动器。

cues.en: What's your problem?
cues.zh: 你有什么问题？

cues.en: Well, I just...
cues.zh: 嗯，我只是……

cues.en: I can't... I'm trying to... I I I can't talk. Well, hurry up. My screensaver's about to kick in.
cues.zh: 我没法……我正在试着……我我我说不出话。嗯，快点。我的屏保快启动了。

cues.en: I'm doing the quarterly again.
cues.zh: 我又在做季度报表了。

cues.en: And I copied the spreadsheets into this new file and this stupid computer just screwed up all my columns. Oh, it's a computer that's stupid, not you, right?
cues.zh: 我把电子表格复制到这个新文件里，这台蠢电脑就把我的列全弄乱了。哦，是电脑蠢，不是你蠢，对吧？

cues.en: The computer's screwed. Yeah, okay. Alright. I try to cut and paste it. Cut and paste. Didn't I tell you these guys were stupid? Yeah. Go to your go to your default font and change it to the spreadsheet font.
cues.zh: 电脑坏了。对，好吧。行，我试试剪切粘贴。剪切粘贴。我不是说过这些家伙很蠢吗？对。去把你的默认字体改成电子表格的字体。

cues.en: My my spreadsheet has a... Move.
cues.zh: 我的电子表格有个……移动。

cues.en: Was that so hard? I didn't know my spreadsheet had a font. Obviously.
cues.zh: 有那么难吗？我都不知道我的电子表格还能改字体。显然你不知道。

cues.en: Hey, you know, they're training monkeys down at the zoo to use computers. Maybe I'll sign you up for a class.
cues.zh: 嘿，动物园那边正在训练猴子用电脑呢，要不给你报个班？

cues.en: Hey, Nick. Hey, Wang.
cues.zh: 嘿，Nick。嘿，Wang。

cues.en: How are things going today? About as fast as an LC four seventy five with a 32 bit processor. Yeah. LC four seventy five. Oh.
cues.zh: 今天进度怎么样？大概跟装了 32 位处理器的 LC 475 一样快吧。是啊，LC 475。呵。

cues.en: I gotta remember that one on the chat rooms. So what's your deal?
cues.zh: 我得把这梗记下来去聊天室用。所以你到底怎么了？

cues.en: You know the craziest things happening? What? You stop thinking about pudding for ten seconds?
cues.zh: 你知道发生了一件多离谱的事吗？怎么，你终于有十秒钟没去想布丁了？

cues.en: Come
cues.zh: 来

cues.en: on. I wanna open this file,
cues.zh: 打开这个文件

cues.en: but it said I don't have enough memory. Okay. Drag your cursor up to the right side of the menu.
cues.zh: 但系统提示内存不足。好，把光标拖到菜单右侧。

cues.en: Well, where's the menu? Oh, last thing I expect you not to be able to find is the menu.
cues.zh: 菜单在哪儿？哎，我最没想到你会找不到的就是菜单。

cues.en: Alright. You just show me where it is. Move.
cues.zh: 好吧，你直接指给我看它在哪。快动啊。

cues.en: Was that so hard? Wang, go help out the queen of Tetris over there. Okay.
cues.zh: 有那么难吗？Wang，去帮帮那边那位俄罗斯方块女王。好的。

cues.en: What's your problem, Einstein?
cues.zh: 你怎么回事，爱因斯坦？

cues.en: Wang, I'm trying to download an attachment from an email, but when I try it, it says I need a file converter. So then I tried to save it to Word first, but it won't let me. So what can I do?
cues.zh: Wang，我想从邮件里下载一个附件，但一点就提示需要文件转换器。然后我试着先存成 Word，又不让存。我该怎么办？

cues.en: Lou.
cues.zh: Lou.

cues.en: Did you fix it? Yeah. You fix it. I told you these flapjacks are one meg short of a gig.
cues.zh: 你修好了吗？嗯。是你修的。我跟你说过，这些煎饼离一吉还差一兆。

cues.en: Son of a... Is that you? It's me. Just you.
cues.zh: 妈的……是你吗？是我。就你。

cues.en: Oh, so is idiots over at the R and D. Well, I guess we gotta make like Microsoft
cues.zh: 哦，原来研发部那帮都是白痴。好吧，我看我们得像微软一样

cues.en: and split.
cues.zh: 撤了。

cues.en: L o l.
cues.zh: 哈哈。

cues.en: Let's go.
cues.zh: 走吧。

cues.en: Oh, by the way,
cues.zh: 哦，顺便说一句，

cues.en: you're welcome.
cues.zh: 不客气。
